correctness.rationale: For all a,b>=3 and 0<=t<=min(a,b), the selected defect edges form one fixed ordered matching. Every mixed face has at most two vertices per shore. After collapsing the fixed contractible shore simplices separately, the resulting two-pole CW decomposition is naturally the unreduced suspension of the square complex Q_t with vertices e_ij, added star edges for deleted diagonals and square cells for each deleted-edge pair; because all shore inclusions and cell labels are fixed, these equivalences commute with t-inclusions. Q_0 has ab isolated vertices; for t>=1 it has a single main component plus (a-t)(b-t) isolates, so reduced H0 differences give degree-one integral basis surviving precisely while both indices >t. In the connected core, leaves collapse and every filled quadrilateral collapses across one path, leaving a subdivision of K_t; the star-at-1 integral fundamental cycles zeta_ij for 2<=i<j<=t are primitive. They are literally retained under inclusion; hence all H1 maps split surjectively, all H2 split injectively, and barcodes [0,1)^(a+b-2), [0,k)^(a+b-2k+1), [t,infty)^(t-2). Independent direct counts for (3,3),(3,4),(4,5) match stage ranks. Source verify_persistence.py constructs actual simplicial filtrations and mod-two finite barcodes for six a,b<=5, but does not on its own prove universal integral functoriality.
